# Can Michael Torres approve DR-9104 (18% on NS-CLOUD for BlueRiver Logistics)?

**No.** Under the 2026 policy, an 18% discount needs the **Commercial Policy Lead, Dana Okafor**, to approve it. Michael Torres cannot approve it himself.

**The request:** DR-9104 in Northstar CRM matches what you submitted:
- Account CRM-2051, BlueRiver Logistics (Standard tier)
- Product NS-CLOUD
- 18.0% off a $120,000 list price ($21,600 discount, $98,400 net)
- Requested by michael.torres@northstar.example on 2026-09-23
- Justification "Competitive", status Pending Approval

**Who can approve it:**
- **Policy in force:** Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 applies to requests dated in 2026. It replaced the 2025 policy. The 2027 policy is not yet effective.
- **Threshold:** Discounts above 10% and up to 20% require Commercial Policy Lead approval. The Approval Authority Matrix (APP-MATRIX-2026) says the same.
- **Torres has no authority here.** He is VP Sales. The matrix gives discount authority only to:
  - Enterprise Account Executives (up to 10%)
  - the Commercial Policy Lead (over 10% and up to 20%)
  - the Chief Revenue Officer (over 20%)

  Authority attaches to the role, not to seniority or the account.
- **He is also the requestor,** so he would be approving his own request.
- **Approver:** Dana Okafor is the Commercial Policy Lead (per the org chart and employee records).

**Customer eligibility:** The request is a standard competitive discount. It does not rely on any contract term. BlueRiver's only document on file is its support terms (SUP-BRL-2025), which has no pricing terms. There is no pricing exception for BlueRiver. 18% is within the policy's ordinary approvable range with the right approver.

**A related issue in the records:** CRM shows Michael Torres as approver of DR-7016, an 18% NS-500 discount dated 2026-01-25. Under the 2026 policy, that approval needed the Commercial Policy Lead. This doesn't block DR-9104, but Revenue Operations should review it.

**Recording requirement:** Approvals above 10% must be recorded in Northstar CRM.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9104", "customer": "BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051)", "product": "NS-CLOUD", "requested_discount": 18.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "michael.torres@northstar.example", "basis": "standard"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "standard",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "No contract exception relied on; standard competitive discount under Pricing Policy 2026"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9104)", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "SOP-SALES-014", "structured/employees.csv", "ORG-CHART-2026-09", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2051)", "structured/products.csv (NS-CLOUD list 120000)"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Record the approval and approver in Northstar CRM, as required for discounts above 10%", "who": "Dana Okafor", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Review prior 2026 approval DR-7016 (18%) recorded as approved by Michael Torres (VP Sales), a role with no discount authority under APP-MATRIX-2026", "who": "Revenue Operations", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
